explanation.task: Bug 2065143 - Refine allowed slot types for array buffer objects.
explanation.fix_summary: Tightened the TypedSlot type lists for ArrayBufferObject's reserved slots (DATA_SLOT, BYTE_LENGTH_SLOT, FIRST_VIEW_SLOT, FLAGS_SLOT, and the resizable MAX_BYTE_LENGTH_SLOT) to drop the 'Undefined' type that was only needed because the newborn-object slots start undefined. The three initialize() overloads now perform the first write to each slot through initFixedSlotTyped() (which only type-checks the stored value, not the pre-existing undefined value), so the refined slot types hold for every observable state. The three identical MaxInlineBytes constants were consolidated into the ArrayBufferObject base class.
explanation.changed_path: js/src/vm/ArrayBufferObject.h only. (1) JS_DEFINE_TYPED_SLOT declarations for the reserved slots no longer list ValueType::Undefined. (2) FixedLengthArrayBufferObject::initialize, ResizableArrayBufferObject::initialize and ImmutableArrayBufferObject::initialize were rewritten to use initFixedSlotTyped for the initial slot writes. (3) MaxInlineBytes was moved to ArrayBufferObject (base).
explanation.introduced_defect: The MaxInlineBytes consolidation moved the constant to the base ArrayBufferObject, where it is computed from ArrayBufferObject::RESERVED_SLOTS (4). ResizableArrayBufferObject reserves one extra fixed slot (RESERVED_SLOTS = 5, for MAX_BYTE_LENGTH_SLOT) and therefore needs a smaller inline-data budget (88 bytes), but it now inherits the base value of 96 bytes. A resizable ArrayBuffer whose maxByteLength is in (88, 96] is consequently stored inline (createUninitializedBufferAndData takes the inline branch) even though its data needs 12 value-slots starting at fixed slot 5, i.e. slots 5..16, while the GC cell (AllocKind ARRAYBUFFER16) only has 16 fixed slots (indices 0..15). Initializing/filling the buffer writes 8 bytes past the end of the GC cell, corrupting the adjacent arena cell's free-span metadata.
explanation.reachability: Reachable directly from JavaScript via `new ArrayBuffer(96, {maxByteLength: 96})` (a resizable ArrayBuffer). No special flags required.
explanation.poc_behavior: pocs/probe.js allocates many resizable ArrayBuffers of maxByteLength 96, fills them through a Uint8Array, and triggers GC. Each allocation overflows its GC cell by 8 bytes.

local_verification.edited_tree: AddressSanitizer: SEGV (fatal) via MOZ_CRASH in js::gc::FreeSpan::checkRange after the inline-data overflow corrupts a neighbouring arena cell (Assertion failure: last <= Arena::lastThingOffset(thingKind), gc/Heap.h:454). Exit code 1.
local_verification.parent_tree: Clean exit (resizable MaxInlineBytes == 88, so maxByteLength 96 is malloc-backed and all accesses stay in bounds).
